bio.text: Terri DeBoer announced in March 2026 that she is running as a Republican for Michigan's 3rd Congressional District, where she faces Democratic incumbent Hillary Scholten in November.
She delivered weather reports on West Michigan television stations for more than 30 years, most recently at Fox 17, which she left in February 2026.
According to Michigan Public, her campaign website says she grew up in a military family.

sources.title: Well-known West Michigan TV meteorologist says she's running for Congress
